name: parthenon
description: Parthenon - a multi-agent swarm simulation where Greek philosophers meet the age of AI (a fork of MiroFish)

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others -n "bridge,backend,frontend" -c "magenta,green,cyan" "npm run grok:bridge" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.grok:login: cd backend && uv run python ../bridge/grok_bridge.py login
scripts.grok:status: cd backend && uv run python ../bridge/grok_bridge.py status
scripts.grok:probe: cd backend && uv run python ../bridge/grok_bridge.py probe
scripts.grok:logout: cd backend && uv run python ../bridge/grok_bridge.py logout
scripts.grok:bridge: cd backend && uv run python ../bridge/grok_bridge.py serve
